description: Bring your product context into ChatGPT. This app gives ChatGPT permission-aware access to your live airfocus roadmaps, OKRs, and customer feedback, so every answer is grounded in where your product actually stands. Query roadmap status, triage feedback, draft PRDs and stakeholder updates, and surface cross-team risk. ChatGPT can also create and update items directly from the conversation, writing straight back to airfocus. Make airfocus the product brain behind your work in ChatGPT.
